headline: Local liquidity in the Sultanate of Oman rises to 28.6 billion rials
summary: Total local liquidity in Oman rose 12.7% at the end of May 2026 to 28 billion 601 million 200 thousand rials, up from 25 billion 376 million rials a year earlier. The figures were reported by the Oman News Agency.
why: Domestic liquidity measures money supply in the economy, which shapes credit conditions, lending and banking sector growth.
